description: This file contains security-related functions for JWT token creation, decoding, password hashing, and user role authorization, used within a FastAPI application.

methods.name: verify_password
methods.description: Verifies a plain-text password against a hashed password using passlib.

methods.name: get_password_hash
methods.description: Hashes a password using passlib's bcrypt scheme.

methods.name: _create_token
methods.description: Creates a JWT token with a subject and expiration delta.

methods.name: create_access_token
methods.description: Generates an access token for a user ID with configured expiration.

methods.name: create_refresh_token
methods.description: Generates a refresh token for a user ID with configured expiration.

methods.name: decode_token
methods.description: Decodes a JWT token and returns its payload, handling expiration and invalid token errors.

methods.name: get_current_user
methods.description: FastAPI dependency that retrieves the current authenticated user based on the bearer token.

methods.name: require_roles
methods.description: Creates a dependency that enforces user role restrictions.

methods.name: require_roles_demo_aware
methods.description: Creates a role restriction dependency that allows any authenticated user if DEMO_MODE is true.
